europe_now.title: Moscow Restaurant Bombing
europe_now.summary: A bombing at a Moscow restaurant has resulted in at least three deaths. Russian officials have characterized the incident as a terror attack.

europe_now.title: Energy Crisis in Hungary
europe_now.summary: Drought conditions have caused the shutdown of the Paks nuclear plant. This development has led to warnings of potential energy shortfalls in Hungary.

top_stories.title: Wildfire Crisis in Europe
top_stories.summary: Wildfires are spreading across various regions, including the Athens area in Greece. In France, thousands of firefighters remain deployed to contain a megafire in Gironde.

top_stories.title: Migration Surge in Ceuta
top_stories.summary: A surge in migration has prompted the EU to schedule an emergency meeting. Most migrants who breached the border have since departed from Ceuta.
